svg.title: The shepherd Euphorbos carrying the infant Oedipus, a spear at his hip
svg.desc: Line drawing after the Attic red-figure neck-amphora by the Achilles Painter, c. 450-445 BCE, Paris, Bibliotheque nationale de France, Cabinet des Medailles 372; traced from photographs by ArchaiOptix (CC BY-SA 4.0), changed: unrolled off the vase, views joined, the spear straightened to its full length, hand, face and sandal lines redrawn. This drawing is CC BY-SA 4.0.
